record.original_question: Let Cp(X) denote the space of real-valued continuous functions on X with the topology of pointwise convergence. Does Cp(N^N), where N^N is the Baire space, have the Reznichenko (weak Fréchet-Urysohn) property: for every subset A and every point y in the closure of A but not in A, there exists a countably infinite pairwise disjoint family of finite subsets of A such that every neighborhood of y meets all but finitely many members of that family?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a topological space $X$, let $C_p(X)$ denote the space of all continuous real-valued functions on $X$ endowed with the topology of pointwise convergence (i.e., the subspace topology inherited from $\mathbb{R}^X$ with the product topology). A topological space $Y$ is said to have the Reznichenko property (also called the weak Fréchet–Urysohn property) if for every subset $A \subseteq Y$ and every point $y \in \overline{A} \setminus A$, there exists a countably infinite, pairwise disjoint family $\mathcal{F}$ of finite subsets of $A$ such that for every neighborhood $U$ of $y$ in $Y$, one has $U \cap F \neq \emptyset$ for all but finitely many $F \in \mathcal{F}$.

Let $\mathbb{N}^{\mathbb{N}}$ denote the Baire space, that is, the set of all functions from $\mathbb{N}$ to $\mathbb{N}$ endowed with the product topology (where $\mathbb{N}$ carries the discrete topology).

Determine whether $C_p(\mathbb{N}^{\mathbb{N}})$ has the Reznichenko property.
artifact.status_search_result: The question has been answered affirmatively: it is known that $C_p(X)$ has the Reznichenko (weak Fréchet–Urysohn) property whenever $X$ is an analytic space, and the Baire space $\mathbb{N}^{\mathbb{N}}$ is analytic. This is reflected both in the compilation listing it as solved and in subsequent literature on the Pytkeev and Reznichenko properties of $C_p(X)$.

status_evidence.title: The minimal cardinality where the Reznichenko property fails
status_evidence.snippet: For every analytic space X, Cp(X) is weakly Fréchet-Urysohn.
status_evidence.claim: Since the Baire space N^N is analytic, Cp(N^N) has the Reznichenko property.

status_evidence.title: The Pytkeev property and the Reznichenko property in function spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Results on the Reznichenko property of Cp(X) for analytic X.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent literature confirms the affirmative answer for analytic X, including the Baire space.
